implementation.targetScope: Browser get/set/remove, default attributes, custom converters and scoped instances. Modern ESM/CommonJS; no global/AMD script namespace shim.

caller.scope: Unchanged @aws-amplify/core 6.11.2 CookieStorage setItem/getItem/removeItem/clear. Synthetic local cookie jar; no account or production cookie access.

changes: Independently written from public documentation, standards and black-box current/app comparisons; no upstream implementation source copied.
Zero runtime dependencies. Native percent encoding with ASCII fast path; single-pass named-cookie lookup and no cookie-value cache.
Prototype-named cookies are safe own data properties. Default attributes use only own properties; malformed attribute names/control characters and invalid expiry values reject before writing.

Current first-duplicate behavior is retained; accepts cookie separators without spaces. App3.0.5 instead takes the last duplicate. Immutable attribute/converter snapshots retain converter receivers. Cross-realm Date expiry works.
